Authors: Chenchen Lv, Lingchen Hu, Yaosai Zhang, Chunlan Li, Gengkui Wei, Wei Xin, Li Li

SAGE-Drive: Benefit-Aware Adaptive Reasoning for Autonomous Driving Planning AutonomousDriving

adaptive reasoning benefit prediction trajectory planning computational efficiency gating

简要说明：SAGE-Drive 提出了一种效益感知的门控机制，在自动驾驶规划中选择性地应用显式推理，仅用20%-35%的推理预算即可接近全推理的精度。

TLDR: SAGE-Drive introduces a benefit-aware gating mechanism that selectively applies explicit reasoning in autonomous driving planning, achieving near-full-reasoning accuracy with only 20-35% reasoning budget.

Abstract: Explicit reasoning enables autonomous vehicles (AVs) to interpret complex traffic interactions and support trajectory planning, but introduces additional computational demands. Determining when explicit reasoning can improve planning accuracy remains a key challenge, as its benefits vary across driving scenarios. To address this challenge, this study proposes Scene-Adaptive Gating of Explicit Reasoning for Driving (SAGE-Drive), a benefit-aware adaptive reasoning framework for autonomous driving planning. First, paired planning outcomes with and without explicit reasoning are analyzed to measure the reasoning benefit, i.e., the reduction in planning error achieved by explicit reasoning, which serves as the supervision label. SAGE-Drive then learns to predict these benefits using geometric features of the initial trajectory planned without reasoning and multimodal scene information, and invokes explicit reasoning only for the scenarios with the highest predicted benefits under a predefined reasoning budget. Experiments on 1,497 paired driving scenarios reveal that explicit reasoning improves planning accuracy in 53.5% of cases while degrading it in 46.5%, yielding a near-zero average benefit. On the test set, with a 20% reasoning budget, SAGE-Drive achieves an average displacement error (ADE) of 1.5191 m, compared with 1.5252 m for random selection. At a 35% budget, it achieves an ADE of 1.5148 m, close to the 1.5141 m obtained when reasoning is applied to every scenario. These findings establish the predicted reasoning benefit as an effective criterion for reasoning selection, allowing explicit reasoning to be invoked where it improves planning accuracy at a fraction of its computational cost.

摘要（中文）：显式推理使自动驾驶车辆（AVs）能够解析复杂交通交互并支持轨迹规划，但同时也引入了额外的计算需求。确定何时显式推理能够提升规划精度仍是一个关键挑战，因为其收益在不同驾驶场景中存在差异。为应对这一挑战，本研究提出了一种面向驾驶的场景自适应显式推理门控机制（SAGE-Drive），一种面向自动驾驶规划的收益感知自适应推理框架。首先，对有无显式推理的配对规划结果进行分析，以量化推理收益，即显式推理所带来的规划误差降低量，并将其作为监督标签。随后，SAGE-Drive利用无推理情况下初始轨迹的几何特征及多模态场景信息，学习预测这些收益，并仅在预设推理预算下预测收益最高的场景中调用显式推理。在1,497个配对驾驶场景上的实验表明，显式推理在53.5%的场景中提升了规划精度，而在46.5%的场景中使其下降，平均收益接近零。在测试集上，当推理预算为20%时，SAGE-Drive的平均位移误差（ADE）为1.5191米，而随机选择方法为1.5252米。当预算为35%时，其ADE为1.5148米，接近对所有场景均应用推理时获得的1.5141米。上述研究结果表明，预测的推理收益可作为推理选择的有效判据，使显式推理仅在能够提升规划精度的场景中被调用，同时仅需承担其计算成本的一小部分。

Authors: Donglei Rong, Wenbin Yao, Congcong Bai, Xi Gao, Qiaoqiao Ren, Sheng Jin, Cheng Xu

SuperNav-1.5: Structured Spatial Memory For Agentic Navigation Systems VLN

structured spatial memory agentic navigation multi-session relocalization occupancy map quadruped robot

简要说明：SuperNav-1.5 提出了一种基于区域分割占据图和地图锚定记忆节点的结构化空间记忆，用于跨会话和连续目标的高效智能导航，在基准测试和真实四足机器人上验证了效果。

TLDR: SuperNav-1.5 introduces a structured spatial memory with area-segmented occupancy maps and map-grounded memory nodes for efficient agentic navigation across sessions and successive object goals, demonstrating gains on benchmarks and real quadruped deployment.

Abstract: This paper addresses the challenge of scene-level memory design for efficient navigation across sessions and successive object goals. Recent methods commonly represent a scene using scene graphs or image--text records. However, dense scene-graph representations impose substantial reasoning and context overhead on multimodal large language models, while image--text records cannot be directly converted into executable geometric routes. To address these limitations, we propose SuperNav-1.5, an agentic navigation system equipped with a structured spatial memory constructed by the agent. The memory consists of an area-segmented occupancy map annotated with agent-maintained, map-grounded memory nodes. This map guides the agent toward unvisited areas and provides executable routes to known locations. For multi-session navigation, we introduce agent-guided relocalization, whereby the agent infers an area prior from current observations and stored memory records to constrain geometric matching and localize the robot within the stored map. Together, these designs enable efficient navigation across session and successive object goals. Experiments show that our method outperforms baselines on single-object, multi-object, and demand-driven navigation benchmarks, with particularly strong gains in path efficiency. Multi-session evaluation demonstrates that the constructed memory can be reused, while deployment on a real quadruped robot further shows the system's applicability. Project Page: https://zju3dv.github.io/SuperNav-1.5/

摘要（中文）：本文针对跨会话及连续目标物导航中的场景级记忆设计挑战展开研究。现有方法通常利用场景图或图像-文本记录来表示场景，然而，稠密场景图表示会给多模态大语言模型带来显著的推理和上下文负担，而图像-文本记录则无法直接转换为可执行的几何路径。为解决上述局限，我们提出SuperNav-1.5，一种配备由智能体构建的结构化空间记忆的自主导航系统。该记忆由区域分割的占用地图构成，并标注有智能体维护的、基于地图的记忆节点。该地图既能引导智能体前往未探索区域，也能为已知位置提供可执行的路径。针对多会话导航，我们引入了智能体引导的重定位机制，智能体依据当前观测和存储的记忆记录推断区域先验，以约束几何匹配过程，从而在已存储地图中定位机器人。上述设计共同实现了跨会话及连续目标物的高效导航。实验表明，我们的方法在单目标、多目标及需求驱动导航基准上均优于基线方法，尤其在路径效率方面提升显著。多会话评估证明了所构建记忆的可复用性，而在真实四足机器人上的部署进一步验证了系统的实际适用性。项目主页：https://zju3dv.github.io/SuperNav-1.5/

Authors: Jiarui Guo, Jinkai Zhang, Yuanhong Yu, Yongchen Zai, Futang Zhu, Ruizhen Hu, Sida Peng, Xiaowei Zhou

Performance Evaluation of Nonlinear Model Predictive and Sliding Mode Controllers on a 4-Cable Spatial CSPR in Simscape Locomotion

Nonlinear Model Predictive Control Sliding Mode Control Cable-Suspended Parallel Robot Simscape Multibody Tracking Accuracy

简要说明：本文在四缆索空间悬挂并联机器人上比较了非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）与滑模控制（SMC），通过解析模型和Simscape仿真验证，表明NMPC在跟踪精度和抗扰性上更优，但计算成本更高。

TLDR: This paper compares Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) and Sliding Mode Control (SMC) for a spatial cable-suspended parallel robot (CSPR) using both analytical and Simscape models, showing NMPC achieves better tracking and disturbance rejection at higher computational cost.

Abstract: This paper offers a comprehensive comparative study between Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) and Sliding Mode Control (SMC) applied to a spatial Cable-Suspended Parallel Robot (CSPR) actuated by four cables. The robot is modeled in two parallel ways: (i) via an analytical dynamic model with included cable elasticity and frictional losses, and (ii) in MATLAB Simscape Multibody, capturing realistic physical effects. Both controllers are implemented under identical reference trajectories, system constraints, and tuning strategies. Our results show that NMPC achieves superior tracking accuracy and stronger disturbance rejection compared to SMC, but at the cost of higher computational demand. Moreover, both controllers were tested on an analytical model of the robot and a Simscape model. The close agreement between the two, for both control schemes, confirms the accuracy of the analytical formulation and its consistency with the physics-based simulation. The study highlights the value of physics-based simulation as a complementary tool for validating advanced controllers under realistic conditions, and demonstrates that NMPC offers superior performance for the studied high-precision, constrained CSPR.

摘要（中文）：本文针对由四根缆索驱动的空间缆索悬挂并联机器人（CSPR），对其非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）与滑模控制（SMC）进行了全面的比较研究。该机器人采用两种并行方式建模：（i）通过包含缆索弹性和摩擦损耗的解析动力学模型；（ii）在MATLAB Simscape Multibody中建模，以捕捉真实的物理效应。两种控制器均在相同的参考轨迹、系统约束和整定策略下实现。结果表明，与SMC相比，NMPC实现了更优的跟踪精度和更强的抗扰动能力，但代价是更高的计算需求。此外，两种控制器均在机器人的解析模型和Simscape模型上进行了测试。两种控制方案下两种模型之间的高度一致性，验证了解析公式的准确性及其与基于物理的仿真的一致性。本研究强调了基于物理的仿真作为在现实条件下验证先进控制器的补充工具的价值，并表明NMPC在所研究的高精度、受约束CSPR系统中表现更优。

Authors: Erfun Bayat Sarmadi, Ali Asadi, Moosa Ayati

Self-Upgrading Embodied Agents Other

embodied agent weight-space programming self-improvement weight editing language model

简要说明：一个27B参数的具身智能体通过在夜晚根据自身失败经验直接修改权重张量来提升技能，无需梯度或外部模型，在家庭环境中展现了稳定的多轮自我改进能力。

TLDR: A 27B embodied agent improves its own skills by editing its weight tensor overnight based on its own failed experiences, with no gradients or external models, demonstrating stable multi-round self-improvement in a household environment.

Abstract: An embodied agent built on a language model goes to work with the weights it was given and keeps them for life. To get better, it needs more training, or reflection, memory, search or prompts that cost every step and are lost when the task changes. Editing weights by reasoning, weight-space programming, could end this, but has stayed with models that only reason or relied on a far larger commercial model. We introduce the self-upgrading embodied agent, to our knowledge the first that learns from its own experience by upgrading its own weights on the job, between its tasks, with no training, no gradient, no reward model, no second model, no test-time scaling and no harness or prompt engineering. By day a 27B agent works in a household environment. At night it reads its record, finds many of its steps wasted on replies that reach the token limit before any action, traces the habit to one direction in its hidden states, and rewrites one tensor of its weights. An agent that rewrites itself must first never break itself, so it is its own examiner: it tests every change against its unchanged self on practice tasks and keeps only what holds. When an edit holds, the next day it is a better agent, at the same cost per step: over thousands of held-out episodes, 48 fresh seeds a task, its one kept edit makes it complete significantly more tasks, in fewer steps, with fewer wasted and fewer tokens. This self-improvement is multi-round, stable and continual: through the nights that follow, the upgrade holds, without collapse. Of four sizes of its family, only the 27B agent does this. From here on, an embodied agent need not keep training and inference apart: as it works, it gathers its own experience and upgrades itself, with no separate pre-training or post-training and no human intervention. We believe this opens lifelong continual learning for robots: stable, continual, recursive self-improvement.

摘要（中文）：基于语言模型构建的具身智能体以其初始权重投入工作，并终身保持不变。若要提升性能，它需要额外训练，或依赖反思、记忆、搜索或提示词，而这些方法每一步都会产生成本，且任务变更时即告失效。通过推理来编辑权重——即权重空间编程——本可终结这一困境，但此前仅停留在只能推理的模型层面，或依赖规模远大于自身的商业模型。我们提出了自我升级的具身智能体，据我们所知，这是首个能够从自身经验中学习、在任务间隙通过升级自身权重实现进步的系统，无需训练、无需梯度、无需奖励模型、无需第二模型、无需测试时扩展，也无需外部框架或提示工程。白天，一个27B参数的智能体在家庭环境中工作；夜晚，它阅读自身记录，发现大量步骤浪费在尚未执行任何动作便已达到令牌上限的回复中，将这一习惯追溯至其隐藏状态中的某一方向，并重写自身权重中的一个张量。一个能自我重写的智能体必须首先确保不破坏自身，因此它充当自己的考官：在练习任务上，将每一项改动与未改动的自身进行对照测试，只保留那些经受住考验的改动。当一次编辑通过验证，次日它便成为更优秀的智能体，而单步成本不变：在数千个保留测试场景中，每项任务使用48个全新随机种子，仅一次保留的编辑便使其以更少的步骤、更少的浪费和更少的令牌数完成显著更多的任务。这种自我改进是多轮、稳定且持续的：在随后的每个夜晚，升级保持有效，不会发生崩溃。在该家族的四种参数规模中，唯有27B智能体展现出这一能力。从此以后，具身智能体无需再将训练与推理割裂：它在工作中积累自身经验并自我升级，无需单独的预训练或后训练阶段，也无需人工干预。我们相信，这为机器人开启了终身持续学习之路：稳定、持续、递归的自我改进。

Authors: Jiajun Fan, Neil He, Qinglong Zheng, Changyi Yang, Tong Wei, Andy Mao, Zetian Li, Chaoran Cheng, Hui Ren, Ruihan Guo, Xianrui Zhong, Xizheng Yu, Jingyuan Li, Xi Zhu, Kaiqu Liang, Chang Xu, Zun Qian, Zidi Xiong, Yuezhu Zhao, Xu Huang, Ge Liu

Zhengrong: World Models with Pole-Based Action-Response Factorization for Direct Visual Planning WorldModel

world models direct visual planning pole-based factorization action-conditioned image-goal control

简要说明：本文提出Zhengrong，一种将潜在轨迹分解为初始条件锚点、自由响应和延迟动作响应的世界模型，利用稳定共轭极点实现直接视觉规划，在图像目标控制基准上提高了成功率并降低了延迟。

TLDR: This paper introduces Zhengrong, a world model that factorizes latent trajectories into initial-condition anchors, free responses, and delayed action responses using stable conjugate poles, enabling direct visual planning with improved success rates and lower latency on image-goal control benchmarks.

Abstract: Direct visual world models predict the effects of candidate action sequences without recursive latent rollout, yet they leave the temporal structure of action effects unspecified. We introduce Zhengrong (Zhengrong-PoleWM), a world model that decomposes a latent trajectory into an initial-condition anchor, a free response, and delayed responses to action innovations. Nonlinear networks map visual history and causal action prefixes to response coefficients. A shared bank of stable conjugate poles determines how each response evolves with elapsed time. This factorization preserves nonlinear interactions across actions, anchors predictions exactly at the initial state, prevents future actions from affecting earlier predictions, and yields bounded responses to finite control plans. We derive an exact re-anchoring identity that identifies the additional basis direction $Ψ_κ(s)$ needed to represent shifted trajectory tails. Across four offline image-goal control benchmarks (Cube, TwoRoom, PushT, and Reacher), Zhengrong-PoleWM achieves $90.83\% \pm 0.47\%$ macro-average success over two training seeds at epoch 20, exceeding the strongest baseline (QQWorld) by 6.08 percentage points. Selecting checkpoints by validation loss yields $91.21\% \pm 1.00\%$. In a controlled first-epoch Cube study without restart regularization, neural and pole response heads outperform a generic direct predictor by 20.67 and 23.34 percentage points, respectively. On an NVIDIA A100 GPU, median latency for a full 30-iteration cross-entropy method search ranges from 74 to 87 ms across the four tasks. The mean of these medians is 77.5 ms, a 15.8% latency reduction relative to Fast-LeWM and a $7.1\times$ speedup over autoregressive LeWM.

摘要（中文）：直接视觉世界模型无需递归隐式展开即可预测候选动作序列的效果，但此类模型未明确动作效果的时间结构。我们提出郑融（Zhengrong-PoleWM）——一种将潜在轨迹分解为初始条件锚点、自由响应以及动作创新延迟响应的世界模型。非线性网络将视觉历史与因果动作前缀映射为响应系数。共享的稳定共轭极点库决定各响应随经过时间的演化方式。该分解保留了动作间的非线性交互，将预测精确锚定于初始状态，阻止未来动作影响早期预测，并对有限控制计划产生有界响应。我们推导出一个精确的重锚恒等式，用以识别表示平移轨迹尾部所需附加基方向\(Ψ_κ(s)\)。在四个离线图像目标控制基准（Cube、TwoRoom、PushT和Reacher）上，Zhengrong-PoleWM在第20轮时两个训练种子上的宏平均成功率达\(90.83\% \pm 0.47\%\)，超过最强基线（QQWorld）6.08个百分点。按验证损失选择检查点可获得\(91.21\% \pm 1.00\%\)的结果。在不含重启正则化的受控首轮Cube研究中，神经响应头与极点响应头分别比通用直接预测器高出20.67和23.34个百分点。在NVIDIA A100 GPU上，跨四个任务的完整30次迭代交叉熵法搜索的中位延迟范围为74至87毫秒，其中位数的均值为77.5毫秒，较Fast-LeWM延迟降低15.8%，较自回归LeWM加速\(7.1\times\)。

Authors: Yu Zhang, Jingrui Li, Congyu Wang, Yuhang Cheng, Wenbo Chen, Xiaobo Zhang, Jing Zou, Yuxi Dai

ColonoWorld: Camera-Controlled Full-Procedure Colonoscopy Video Generation WorldModel

colonoscopy world model camera-controlled video generation camera trajectory conditioning 3D tube conditioning autonomous navigation

简要说明：ColonoWorld 是一种结肠镜检查世界模型，根据相机轨迹和结肠的粗略 3D 管状结构生成从盲肠到直肠的完整视频，支持受相机控制的程序生成（包括息肉和器械），用于训练和评估导航系统。

TLDR: ColonoWorld is a colonoscopy world model that generates full cecum-to-rectum videos conditioned on camera trajectories and a coarse 3D tube of the colon, enabling camera-controlled generation of procedures with polyps and instruments for training and evaluating navigation systems.

Abstract: Navigation systems in colonoscopy are advancing from guiding the endoscopist to steering the scope autonomously. Since an incorrect motion can injure the patient, developing and evaluating these systems calls for a world model of colonoscopy. Such a model must follow a commanded scope motion, keep the colon anatomy consistent, and show lesions and procedural events. Yet camera-controlled generators trained on general scenes lose the colon's structure under motion, and endoscopic generators offer no camera control. We present ColonoWorld, a colonoscopy world model conditioned on a camera trajectory and a coarse 3D tube of the colon, trained on in vivo videos. From a whole-colon tube, it generates a full cecum-to-rectum procedure, even for unseen colon shapes. It also places polyps, instruments, and irrigation at specified locations and times. ColonoWorld outperforms state-of-the-art video generators, reducing camera trajectory error by 32% and FVD by 29%. Our code and annotations will be released at https://aidaslab.github.io/ColonoWorld.

摘要（中文）：结肠镜检查中的导航系统正从引导内镜医师向自主操控内窥镜的方向发展。由于不当运动可能对患者造成伤害，开发和评估这些系统需要建立结肠镜检查的世界模型。该模型必须遵循指令化的内窥镜运动、保持结肠解剖结构的一致性，并显示病变及操作过程中的事件。然而，基于通用场景训练的相机控制生成器在运动过程中会丢失结肠结构，而内镜生成器则不具备相机控制能力。我们提出了ColonoWorld，一种以相机轨迹和结肠粗略三维管状结构为条件的结肠镜检查世界模型，并在体内视频上进行训练。该模型能够从整段结肠管状结构生成完整的从盲肠到直肠的操作过程，即使面对未见过的结肠形态也能适用。此外，它还能在指定位置和时间放置息肉、器械和冲洗效果。ColonoWorld优于当前最先进的视频生成器，相机轨迹误差降低了32%，FVD（帧级视频距离）降低了29%。我们的代码和标注将在https://aidaslab.github.io/ColonoWorld公开发布。

Authors: Jihwan Hong, Sunghwan Steve Cho, Ping Shu Ho, Joo Seong Kim, Bokyung Kim, Nam-Joon Kim, Simon See, Ji Won Kim, Jaeyoung Do

DREAM: Dual-Memory Reasoning for Anticipatory 3D Perception in Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

LiDAR semantic segmentation dual-memory continual learning anticipatory perception online setting

简要说明：DREAM提出了一种用于自动驾驶中持续LiDAR语义分割的双重记忆（潜在记忆与错误记忆）框架，实现了无需回放或微调骨干网络的预期性、经验驱动感知。

TLDR: DREAM introduces a dual-memory (latent and error) framework for continual LiDAR semantic segmentation in autonomous driving, enabling anticipatory, experience-driven perception without replay or fine-tuning of the backbone.

Abstract: Autonomous driving systems must not only interpret the current scene but also anticipate perceptual challenges such as occlusions, sparse observations, and recurring failure patterns. However, most existing LiDAR semantic segmentation methods operate in a frame-centric manner, processing each scan independently and discarding past contextual experience, which limits robustness under dynamic scene changes. We propose DREAM, a Dual-memory REAsoning framework for continual LiDAR seMantic segmentation that reframes perception as an experience-driven and anticipatory process. DREAM maintains two complementary memory banks in a strictly online setting: a latent memory that stores compact semantic abstractions of previously observed scenes, and an error memory that records representations associated with uncertain predictions. At each timestep, relevant memory entries are retrieved via cosine similarity and integrated into the feature space through a lightweight modulation mechanism, enabling the model to reinforce consistent semantic patterns while suppressing recurring failure modes. The backbone remains frozen and no past scans are replayed, ensuring computational efficiency and bounded memory growth. Extensive experiments on multiple large-scale LiDAR benchmarks demonstrate that DREAM achieves state-of-the-art performance, with consistent improvements on dynamic and small-scale objects, highlighting the effectiveness of persistent and error-aware memory for robust long-horizon perception.

摘要（中文）：自动驾驶系统不仅要解读当前场景，还需预判诸如遮挡、稀疏观测及重复性故障模式等感知挑战。然而，现有的大多数激光雷达语义分割方法采用以帧为中心的处理方式，独立处理每次扫描并丢弃过往的上下文经验，这限制了其在动态场景变化下的鲁棒性。为此，我们提出了DREAM，一种面向持续激光雷达语义分割的双存储推理框架，将感知重新定义为经验驱动且具有前瞻性的过程。DREAM在严格的在线设置下维护两个互补的存储库：一个是潜在存储，用于保存先前观测场景的紧凑语义抽象；另一个是错误存储，用于记录与不确定预测相关的表征。在每个时间步，通过余弦相似度检索相关存储条目，并借助轻量级调制机制将其融入特征空间，从而使模型能够强化一致的语义模式，同时抑制反复出现的故障模式。骨干网络保持冻结，且不重放历史扫描，从而确保计算效率及存储增长的有限性。在多个大规模激光雷达基准上的广泛实验表明，DREAM达到了最先进的性能，尤其在动态物体和小尺度物体上表现出一致的改进，凸显了持久且具备错误感知能力的记忆在稳健长时感知中的有效性。

world-model planning latent motion representation long-horizon planning goal-reaching dynamics prediction

简要说明：MotionPort 学习身体运动的低维潜在表示，通过按运动相似性组织搜索空间来改善动力学预测和长时程规划，从而在多个领域提升目标达成成功率。

TLDR: MotionPort learns low-dimensional latent representations of body motion that improve dynamics prediction and long-horizon planning by organizing the search space by motion similarity, boosting goal-reaching success across multiple domains.

Abstract: We introduce MotionPort, which learns low-dimensional latent representations of body motion for accurate dynamics prediction and effective long-horizon planning. Existing world-model planners often search over action representations learned for prediction, yet we show that predictive accuracy alone does not ensure that optimization can discover successful trajectories. MotionPort addresses this mismatch by representing body trajectories rather than action chunks and organizing the search space by motion similarity, helping predicted improvements translate into successful execution. Without fine-tuning state encoders, MotionPort raises average goal-reaching success from 37.9% to 87.8% across three backbones and seven settings in four domains. On the evaluated AntMaze-OGBench tasks, it achieves 72% success, compared with 4% for the strongest baseline.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了MotionPort，该方法学习身体运动的低维潜在表征，以实现精准的动力学预测和高效的长时程规划。现有的世界模型规划器通常针对专为预测而学习的动作表征进行搜索，然而我们证明，仅凭预测准确性并不能确保优化过程能够发现成功的轨迹。MotionPort通过表征身体轨迹而非动作片段，并依据运动相似性组织搜索空间来应对这一不匹配问题，从而帮助预测中的改进有效转化为实际执行中的成功。在不微调状态编码器的情况下，MotionPort在四个领域的七种设置、三种主干网络上，将平均目标到达成功率从37.9%提升至87.8%。在评估的AntMaze-OGBench任务上，其成功率达到72%，而最强基线仅为4%。

Authors: Renhao Zhang, Abhranil Chandra, Bruno Castro da Silva

Completing analytical conversion scheme among DH, Hayati, CPC and POE models for manipulator calibration Manipulation

kinematic calibration analytical conversion DH model POE model Lie group theory

简要说明：本文完善了机械臂标定中 DH、Hayati、CPC 和 POE 运动学模型之间的解析转换体系，基于李群理论提出了 POE-HAY 和 HAY-CPC 的新型转换方法，并通过仿真和 ABB IRB 1600 机械臂的实际标定实验进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper completes the analytical conversion scheme among DH, Hayati, CPC, and POE kinematic models for manipulator calibration, introducing novel POE-HAY and HAY-CPC conversions based on Lie group theory, and validates them through simulations and real-world calibration experiments on an ABB IRB 1600 manipulator.

Abstract: Building on Mooring's decomposition of the calibration procedure into four stages - modeling, measurement, identification, and correction - this paper investigates the role of analytical kinematic model conversion algorithms within the calibration framework and their potential to improve calibration performance. Four prominent and widely cited kinematic models: Denavit-Hartenberg (DH), Hayati (HAY), Complete and Parametrically Continuous (CPC), and Product of Exponentials (POE), - are considered. A systematic analysis of the existing conversion relationships reveals that, although most conversions among these models have already been established in the literature, a direct analytical conversion between POE and HAY, and CPC and HAY remains unavailable. Relying instead on a sequential combination of the existing POE-DH and DH-HAY conversions, for example, introduces several limitations. To address this gap, we develop a constructive analytical conversion between POE-HAY and HAY-CPC models based on Lie group theory, formally established through a set of lemmas and propositions. The proposed algorithms are illustrated using an RRRP SCARA robot and an RRHHHH Puma 560 manipulator. The direct POE-HAY conversion is compared with the sequential POE-DH-HAY approach, as well as HAY-CPC in terms of several relevant criteria, demonstrating the advantages of the proposed solution. Finally, we demonstrate the practical significance of the completed analytical conversion framework in an open-loop kinematic calibration experiment on an ABB IRB 1600 manipulator, using an API Radian EMSD3 Laser Tracker for measurements. The experimental results demonstrate that proper model selection combined with completed analytical conversion scheme directly improves calibration accuracy.

摘要（中文）：基于Mooring将标定流程分解为建模、测量、辨识与补偿四个阶段的理论框架，本文探讨了分析式运动学模型转换算法在标定框架中的作用及其提升标定性能的潜力。研究选取四种具有代表性和广泛引用的运动学模型：Denavit-Hartenberg (DH)、Hayati (HAY)、Complete and Parametrically Continuous (CPC) 以及 Product of Exponentials (POE)。对现有转换关系的系统分析表明，尽管这些模型之间的大多数转换已在文献中建立，但POE与HAY之间以及CPC与HAY之间的直接分析式转换仍然缺失。转而依赖现有的POE-DH和DH-HAY转换的序贯组合则会引入若干局限性。为弥补这一空白，本文基于李群理论构建了POE-HAY与HAY-CPC模型之间的构造性分析转换方法，并通过一系列引理和命题予以正式论证。 利用RRRP型SCARA机器人和RRHHHH型Puma 560机械臂对所提算法进行了验证。将直接POE-HAY转换与序贯POE-DH-HAY方法及HAY-CPC方法从多个相关准则维度进行比较，结果表明所提方案具有显著优势。最后，在ABB IRB 1600机械臂上开展了开环运动学标定实验，采用API Radian EMSD3激光跟踪仪进行测量，验证了完整分析式转换框架的实际应用价值。实验结果表明，合理的模型选择结合完整的分析式转换方案可直接提升标定精度。

Authors: Oleg Yu. Sumenkov, Danil D. Kulminskiy, Sergei V. Gusev

Can Multimodal Fusion MakeSense for Embodied Vision in Degraded Sensing? Other

multimodal fusion embodied vision negative fusion sensor subsets world model

简要说明：MakeSense提出了一种多模态融合框架，通过保留传感器特定证据并惩罚负融合，提升了无人机定位、协同3D检测和人形机器人控制等多种具身感知任务的性能。

TLDR: MakeSense is a multimodal fusion framework that preserves sensor-specific evidence and penalizes negative fusion, improving embodied perception and command prediction across diverse tasks including UAV localization, cooperative 3D detection, and humanoid control.

Abstract: Embodied vision systems rely on complementary sensors to perceive and act as conditions change. Even models that accept arbitrary sensor subsets can exhibit negative fusion: adding a sensor increases prediction error. We propose MakeSense, a multimodal fusion framework that preserves sensor-specific evidence in private streams and combines information through shared bottleneck tokens. Training pairs full and subset views of the same degraded observations, penalizing higher error with more sensors. Where geometry permits, the distance readout uses range measurements alone, while the rest of the prediction draws on all available inputs. Paired tests across five datasets reveal helpful and harmful sensor additions. MakeSense reduces negative fusion on MM-Fi. With lightweight adapters and per-dataset training, the same design improves UAV localization on MMAUD, cooperative 3D detection on V2X-Real, few-shot pose transfer to RELI11D, and command prediction on Humanoid-Everyday, where a world model trained on the frozen core's outputs forecasts future fused states more accurately than a linear baseline at longer tested horizons. MakeSense supports embodied sensing across human activity, aerial systems, robotics, and autonomous driving.

摘要（中文）：具身视觉系统依赖互补传感器，在条件变化时进行感知与行动。即使能够接受任意传感器子集的模型，也可能出现负融合现象：增加传感器反而导致预测误差上升。我们提出MakeSense，一种多模态融合框架，在私有流中保留传感器特定证据，并通过共享瓶颈令牌整合信息。训练过程中，将完整视图与子集视图配对，输入相同的退化观测数据，对传感器更多但误差更大的情况施加惩罚。在几何条件允许时，距离读数仅依赖测距传感器，其余预测则利用所有可用输入。在五个数据集上的配对测试揭示了有益与有害的传感器新增情况。MakeSense在MM-Fi数据集上减少了负融合现象。借助轻量级适配器和逐数据集训练，同一设计在MMAUD上提升了无人机定位性能，在V2X-Real上改善了协同三维检测，在RELI11D上实现了少样本姿态迁移，并在Humanoid-Everyday上提升了指令预测能力。在Humanoid-Everyday中，基于冻结核心输出训练的世界模型，在较长的测试时域上对未来融合状态的预测比线性基线更为准确。MakeSense支持跨人类活动、空中系统、机器人和自动驾驶领域的具身感知应用。

EgoDepth-Bench: Benchmarking Metric Depth for Egocentric Manipulation Perception3D

简要说明：提出了一个大规模第一人称操作数据集，包含多视角RGB和度量深度，并基准测试了深度估计模型，微调后性能显著提升。

TLDR: Introduces a large-scale egocentric manipulation dataset with multi-view RGB and metric depth, and benchmarks depth estimation models, showing significant improvement after fine-tuning.

Abstract: We introduce EgoDepth-Bench, comprising 941,233 synchronized samples collected across 37 distinct physical environments. Each sample combines six calibrated RGB views with metric depth in the native fisheye view, reconstructed from five active-infrared stereo modules. A calibrated ball-bar confirms millimeter-level geometric accuracy, with a median error of 1.27 mm on a known sphere spacing. Environment-held-out splits enable evaluation of generalization to unseen environments. Across monocular, stereo, and multi-view models, the benchmark measures both depth accuracy and prediction coverage, including on hands and objects. Fine-tuning MapAnything on EgoDepth-Bench reduces metric AbsRel from 0.708 to 0.091 and scale-aligned AbsRel from 0.327 to 0.072 on unseen environments. These results demonstrate that EgoDepth-Bench provides effective supervision and enables rigorous evaluation of metric and relative depth estimation in egocentric manipulation. The project page provides the evaluation code and interactive RGB-depth sequences.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了EgoDepth-Bench，该基准数据集包含在37个不同物理环境中收集的941,233个同步样本。每个样本将六个经过标定的RGB视图与原生鱼眼视图中的度量深度相结合，这些深度数据由五个主动红外立体模块重建而来。经标定的球杆仪验证，其几何精度达到毫米级，在已知球体间距上的中值误差为1.27毫米。通过环境留出划分，该基准能够评估模型对未见环境的泛化能力。在单目、立体及多视图模型上，该基准同时衡量深度精度和预测覆盖率，包括对手部和物体的预测。在EgoDepth-Bench上对MapAnything进行微调后，其在未见环境中的度量绝对相对误差（AbsRel）从0.708降至0.091，尺度对齐的绝对相对误差从0.327降至0.072。这些结果表明，EgoDepth-Bench能够提供有效的监督信号，并支持对自我中心操作中度量深度和相对深度估计进行严格评估。项目页面提供了评估代码及交互式RGB-深度序列。

Authors: Yuan Gao, Dongchen Wei, Xinyang Lin, Shuhua Cao, Xueliang Guo, Zhuohan Li, Yihao Wang

Autonomous UAV Navigation in an Unknown Environment via Multi-Trajectory Model Predictive Control Other

model predictive control UAV navigation obstacle avoidance LiDAR unknown environment

简要说明：本文提出了一种多轨迹模型预测控制（mt-MPC）方法，用于无人机在未知环境中基于LiDAR的自主导航与避障，仿真结果表明其性能优于标准MPC。

TLDR: This paper presents a multi-trajectory model predictive control (mt-MPC) formulation for autonomous UAV navigation in unknown environments with LiDAR-based obstacle avoidance, demonstrating improved performance over standard MPC in simulation.

Abstract: A novel model predictive control (MPC) formulation, named multi-trajectory MPC (mt-MPC), is presented and applied to the problem of autonomous navigation of an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) in an unknown environment. The UAV is equipped with a LiDAR sensor, providing only a partial description of the surroundings and resulting in time-varying constraints as the vehicle navigates among the obstacles. The control system layout is hierarchical: the low-level loops stabilize the vehicle's trajectories and track the set-points commanded by the high-level, mt-MPC controller. The latter is required to plan the UAV trajectory trading off safety, i.e. to avoid collisions with the uncertain obstacles, and exploitation, i.e. to reach an assigned target location. To achieve this goal, mt-MPC considers different future state trajectories in the same Finite Horizon Optimal Control Problem (FHOCP), enabling a partial decoupling between constraint satisfaction (safety) and cost function minimization (exploitation). Recursive feasibility and, consequently, persistent obstacle avoidance guarantees are derived under the assumption of a time invariant environment. The performance of the approach is studied in simulation and compared with that of a standard MPC, showing good improvement.

摘要（中文）：提出了一种新颖的模型预测控制（MPC）方案，命名为多轨迹模型预测控制（mt-MPC），并将其应用于无人机（UAV）在未知环境中的自主导航问题。该无人机配备有激光雷达传感器，仅能提供周围环境的部分描述，导致无人机在障碍物间导航时面临时变约束。控制系统布局为分层结构：底层回路负责稳定飞行轨迹，并跟踪由高层mt-MPC控制器下达的设定点。高层控制器需权衡安全性与探索性来规划无人机轨迹，即既要避免与不确定障碍物碰撞（安全性），又要到达指定目标位置（探索性）。为实现该目标，mt-MPC在同一有限时域最优控制问题（FHOCP）中考虑多条未来状态轨迹，从而在约束满足（安全性）与成本函数最小化（探索性）之间实现部分解耦。在时不变环境假设下，推导了递归可行性和持续性避碰保证。该方法的性能通过仿真研究，并与标准MPC进行了对比，结果显示其具有明显改进。

Authors: Danilo Saccani, Lorenzo Fagiano

GeLiFiSH: Recursive LiDAR Keypoint Estimation with Ground and Moving Object Segmentation Perception3D

LiDAR keypoint estimation sequential probability ratio test ground segmentation moving object segmentation registration

简要说明：GeLiFiSH 是一种无学习的递归 LiDAR 关键点检测器，通过在滚动体素地图上使用序贯假设检验融合重复观测，并利用地面与动态物体分割提升跨传感器和跨会话的可重复性与配准召回率。

TLDR: GeLiFiSH is a learning-free, recursive LiDAR keypoint detector that fuses repeated observations via a sequential hypothesis test on a rolling voxel map, using ground and moving-object segmentation to improve repeatability and registration recall across sensors and sessions.

Abstract: LiDAR registration and loop closure often rely on sparse keypoints, which must remain repeatable across sessions, viewpoints, and sensors. To handle differing scan patterns, detectors typically operate on accumulated submaps, which introduces latency and processes each submap independently, so repeated observations are never fused. Height-based detectors also reference structure to an estimated ground, so its inconsistency across sessions propagates into the keypoints. Moreover, dynamic objects leave ghost trails that can be mistaken for static structure. We present GeLiFiSH (Geometric LiDAR Filtering with Sequential Hypothesis testing), a learning-free filter that recursively estimates persistent keypoints at scan rate. A height-structure detector runs on a rolling voxel map, and detections initialize tracks with a position, covariance, and existence probability, accepted or rejected by a sequential probability ratio test. Ground segmentation provides a sensor-agnostic height reference, and moving object segmentation removes dynamic points before map insertion. On SemanticKITTI, HeLiMOS, and HeLiPR, spanning five LiDARs and multiple sessions, GeLiFiSH attains the highest average keypoint repeatability among the compared detectors and the second-highest cross-session registration recall from keypoints alone, behind ISS which extracts four times as many keypoints. With one parameter set and no sensor-height prior, both ground and moving object segmentation modules outperform their baselines on average.

摘要（中文）：激光雷达配准与回环检测通常依赖于稀疏关键点，而这些关键点必须在不同采集时段、视角及传感器之间保持可重复性。为应对不同的扫描模式，检测器通常基于累积子图进行操作，这种做法会引入延迟，并对每个子图独立处理，导致重复观测信息始终未被融合。此外，基于高度的方法通常将结构参考至估计的地平面，而地平面在不同采集时段间的不一致性会进一步传递至关键点中。同时，动态物体会留下鬼影轨迹，可能被误认为静态结构。我们提出GeLiFiSH（基于序贯假设检验的几何激光雷达滤波方法），这是一种免学习的滤波器，能够以扫描频率递推估计持久关键点。高度结构检测器在滚动体素地图上运行，检测结果初始化带有位置、协方差和存在概率的轨迹，并通过序贯概率比检验予以接受或拒绝。地面分割提供了与传感器无关的高度参考，移动物体分割则在建图插入之前移除动态点。在覆盖五种激光雷达和多个采集时段的SemanticKITTI、HeLiMOS和HeLiPR数据集上，GeLiFiSH在比较的检测器中取得了最高的平均关键点可重复性，并且仅凭关键点便取得了第二高的跨时段配准召回率，仅次于提取关键点数量为前者四倍的ISS方法。在仅使用一组参数且不依赖传感器高度先验的情况下，地面分割与移动物体分割模块的平均性能均优于其基线方法。

Authors: Nikolaos Stathoulopoulos, George Nikolakopoulos

Trustworthy agentic lunar robotics: safety-constrained contingent planning with a foundation-model planner Other

contingent planning foundation-model planner safety constraints lunar robotics irreversible actions

简要说明：本文提出了非对称知识级重规划（AKR），一种安全约束的应急规划框架，将基础模型规划器视为不可信黑箱，用于月球机器人，在执行不可逆动作前验证前提条件。在蒙特卡洛试验和全栈运行中证明了高安全性和可靠性。

TLDR: This paper introduces asymmetric knowledge-level replanning (AKR), a safety-constrained contingent planning framework that uses a foundation-model planner as an untrusted black box for lunar robotics, verifying preconditions before irreversible actions. It demonstrates high safety and reliability in Monte Carlo trials and full-stack runs.

Abstract: Sustained lunar-base operations require robots that restore equipment and deliver cargo under conditions unforeseen before deployment. Flown space autonomy executes pre-validated procedures and enters a safe hold outside their scope, whereas foundation models synthesize plans on site that cannot be verified before execution. We formulate these operations as safety-constrained contingent planning with irreversible actions, erroneous records, three-valued physical evidence, and costly, deadline-constrained sensing. We propose asymmetric knowledge-level replanning (AKR), which treats the planner as an untrusted black box: reversible actions run on the planner's assumptions, and irreversible actions run only after a minimum-cost sensing cover verifies every precondition. Under sound measurements, no irreversible action executes on a false precondition for any planner or record, the sensing cost before an irreversible action is bounded below for every sound knowledge-based policy, and execution with a complete planner ends in a verified goal or a certified hold. AKR executed no hazardous action in 21,000 Monte Carlo trials with sound observations or in 58 full-stack runs; the FF-Replan acting rule executed one in 7% of those trials. The median AKR run took 1.10 times the fastest run on the same mission, against 1.50 under the K-replanner acting rule. AKR completed 20 of 21 contingency and sequential-fault runs with an unchanged task model; the original PLEXIL and EUROPA$\rightarrow$PLEXIL procedures completed none.

摘要（中文）：摘要：持续的月球基地运行需要机器人在部署前未曾预见的条件下恢复设备并运送货物。已上天的空间自主系统会执行经过预先验证的程序，并在超出其范围时进入安全保持状态，而基础模型则能在现场合成计划，但这些计划无法在执行前得到验证。我们将这些运行任务形式化为带有不可逆动作、错误记录、三值物理证据以及成本高昂且受截止时间约束的感知的安全约束偶发规划问题。我们提出了非对称知识层面重规划（AKR）方法，该方法将规划器视为不可信的黑盒：可逆动作基于规划器的假设执行，而不可逆动作仅在最小成本感知覆盖验证了所有前置条件之后才执行。在测量结果正确的条件下，任何不可逆动作都不会基于错误前置条件执行，无论采用何种规划器或记录；对于任何基于知识的可靠策略，在执行不可逆动作前的感知成本都有下界；使用完整规划器执行时，整个过程会以验证目标或认证保持状态结束。AKR在21,000次蒙特卡洛试验（观测数据正确）和58次全栈运行中均未执行任何危险动作；而FF-Replan动作规则在7%的试验中执行了危险动作。AKR的中位运行时间为同一任务最快运行时间的1.10倍，而K-重规划器动作规则为1.50倍。AKR在任务模型不变的情况下完成了21次偶发与连续故障运行中的20次；而原有的PLEXIL和EUROPA$\rightarrow$PLEXIL流程则未能完成任何一次。

Authors: Bingqi Huang, Bingchuan Wei, Yingkai Cai, Zhaokui Wang

Confidently Lost: Silent Failure and Edge Deployment of Dense Visual SLAM under Photon Starvation Perception3D

dense visual SLAM low-light robustness silent failure detection learned two-view geometry edge deployment

简要说明：本文研究了密集视觉SLAM在弱光条件下的静默失败，揭示了学习几何网络在光子匮乏场景中会产生虚假信心，并提出了一种无需真值即可检测该失败的指标。

TLDR: This paper studies silent failure of dense visual SLAM under low-light conditions, showing that learned geometry networks manufacture false confidence in photon-starved scenes and proposing a metric to detect this failure without ground truth.

Abstract: Dense visual SLAM built on learned two-view geometry is evaluated in good light; in low light it fails silently. Two frames of 9-level quantized noise, no scene at all, give MASt3R-SLAM's network a cross-view geometric self-consistency of 0.936; a real dark frame pair gives 0.935. Starved of structure, the network invents the same geometry for both views and the system trusts the agreement: on a dark sequence it consumes 1,605 frames, emits 7 keyframes, rejects no factor-graph edges and reports full frame rate, while over 95% of the correspondences it accepts violate the ground-truth epipolar geometry. One inflated statistic is read by two subsystems against thresholds in opposite directions, so keyframing starves while relocalization accepts almost every candidate. The same statistic, read at keyframe-pair baselines, separates the confident collapse from working runs on the ETH3D dark sequences without ground truth or extra computation (in-sample). Low-light-adapted weights take tracked trajectories from 1/6 to 5/6, as does retuning two thresholds; neither yields accurate ones, because the adaptation withdraws confidence from wrong geometry rather than finding right geometry. Replayed on a Jetson AGX Orin carried by a legged robot, the mechanism's signature reproduces on the two darkest of four routes, and which of its faces appears varies with route geometry and sensor encoding. The network does not lose confidence in the dark; it manufactures it.

摘要（中文）：基于学习到的双视角几何构建的稠密视觉SLAM在光照良好时表现可靠，但在低光环境下会无声失效。两帧经过9级量化的噪声图——完全不含任何场景内容——便能让MASt3R-SLAM的网络产生0.936的跨视角几何自一致性；真实暗光帧对则给出0.935。当缺乏结构信息时，网络会为两个视角虚构出相同的几何结构，而系统误信了这种一致性：在一个暗光序列中，系统消耗了1,605帧，生成7个关键帧，未拒绝任何因子图边，并报告了满帧率，但其接受的相关点对中，超过95%违反了真实极线几何约束。这一被放大的统计量被两个子系统读取，并分别用于方向相反的阈值判定，导致关键帧选取被抑制，而重定位却几乎接受每一个候选帧。同样的统计量在关键帧对的基线上读取时，无需真值或额外计算，即可在ETH3D暗光序列中将“自信崩溃”与正常运行区分开来（样本内）。低光自适应权重将跟踪轨迹从1/6提升至5/6，调节两个阈值也能达到同样效果；但两者都无法产生精确轨迹，因为这种自适应是从错误的几何中收回置信度，而非寻找正确的几何。在搭载于足式机器人的Jetson AGX Orin上重放时，该机制的标志性特征在四条路线中最暗的两条上复现，其表现面随路线几何和传感器编码方式的不同而变化。网络在黑暗中并未失去置信度，而是主动制造了置信度。

Authors: Shrikrishna Bhagirath Rajule, Srinath Neelamagam, Aniket Bera

How Should a Home Robot Update Its Memories When Human Routines Change? Other

robot memory language model home robot routine change simulated households

简要说明：本文研究了当人类日常习惯改变时，家用机器人应如何更新物体位置的记忆，在模拟家庭中比较了基于规则、基于摘要和基于原始历史记录的语言模型方法，发现保留原始观察历史对于适应反复出现的习惯至关重要。

TLDR: This paper investigates how home robots should update their memory of object locations when human routines change, comparing rule-based, summary-based, and raw-history language model approaches in simulated households, finding that preserving raw sighting history is crucial for adapting to recurring routines.

Abstract: A home robot that helps with chores needs to know where objects are, but people move objects according to routines that change and later change back. The robot's memory must adapt to the new routine without erasing experience that may become useful again. One approach is to have a language model maintain written summaries of the home from the robot's own observations, but existing evaluations of such memories use static worlds. We explore simulated households where a resident gets sick, recovers, and later gets sick again. We compare a rule that keeps every room an object has been seen in, language-model memories that store only written summaries, and language-model memories that can also read the raw history of sightings. The rule outperforms every summary-only memory, and giving language models the sighting history closes the gap. Surprisingly, writing summaries on top of the history adds nothing we can measure. When the illness returns, methods that keep the history search better than they did the first time, while summary-only methods show no consistent improvement. Deleting the first illness from memory removes all of the rule's gain and part of theirs. The summaries recorded where objects went during the illness but rarely distinguished sick-day patterns from normal routines. Our findings suggest that common approaches to summarizing robot memories struggle to remember facts about a routine that might return, highlighting the need for future benchmarks to evaluate this aspect of long-term robot deployment.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 协助家务的家用机器人需要知道物体的位置，但人们会根据不断变化、随后又恢复原状的日常习惯移动物体。机器人的记忆必须适应新的习惯，同时又不抹除未来可能再次有用的经验。一种方法是由语言模型根据机器人自身的观察，维护关于家庭环境的书面摘要，但现有的此类记忆评估均基于静态世界。我们探索了模拟家庭场景，其中一位居民生病、康复，随后再次生病。我们比较了三种方法：规则方法（保留每个物体出现过的所有房间）、只存储书面摘要的语言模型记忆，以及既能存储书面摘要又能读取原始目击历史的语言模型记忆。结果显示，规则方法优于所有仅使用摘要的记忆方法，而让语言模型获得目击历史后，其表现与规则方法相当。令人意外的是，在历史记录之上再撰写摘要并未带来任何可测量的额外收益。当疾病再次发生时，保留历史记录的方法在搜索上的表现优于首次患病时，而仅使用摘要的方法则没有表现出一致的改进。从记忆中删除第一次患病经历后，规则方法的全部优势消失，而其他方法的优势也部分丧失。摘要记录了患病期间物体的去向，但很少将病日模式与正常日常习惯区分开来。我们的研究结果表明，常见的机器人记忆摘要方法难以记住可能再次出现的习惯相关事实，这凸显了未来基准测试需要评估长期机器人部署中这一方面的必要性。

Authors: Oliver Wang, Mani Srivastava

Superellipse Function: A Powerful Geometric Tool for the Design and Deformation Modeling of Tendon-Driven Continuum Manipulators With Flexural Patterns Experiencing Tension Loss Manipulation

superellipse function tendon-driven continuum manipulators flexural patterns tension loss design space

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于超椭圆函数的几何框架，用于设计和建模具有屈曲模式的腱驱动连续机械臂，并通过仿真和实验解决了摩擦导致的张力损失问题。

TLDR: The paper introduces a Superellipse-function-based geometric framework for designing and modeling tendon-driven continuum manipulators with flexural patterns, addressing tension loss from friction via simulations and experiments.

Abstract: In this article, we feature the Superellipse function as a geometric and versatile tool for effective design and modeling of flexural patterns (FPs) in tendon-driven continuum manipulators (TD-CMs) with discontinuous cross section geometries. We also propose a unique complementary mathematical framework and solution algorithm for modeling the effects of distributed and concentrated friction forces- caused by partially-constrained tendons- on tension loss and deformation behavior of a TD-CM designed using a Superellipse function. Particularly, by employing this geometric function, we establish four intuitive functional mappings relating the manipulator's geometric parameters, kinematics, and deformation behavior. Thanks to the features of these intuitive mappings and Superellipse function, we then introduce the concepts of design space and design curve to facilitate intuitive design of a TD-CM with a generic FP geometry experiencing tendon tension loss. To thoroughly evaluate the performance of this novel framework and its aforementioned features, we performed various simulation and experimental studies on TD-CMs designed and fabricated based on a Superellipse function. Results were then analyzed and compared using different error metrics.

摘要（中文）：本文重点介绍了超椭圆函数作为一种几何多功能工具，用于具有不连续截面几何形状的腱驱动连续型机械臂中弯曲模式的有效设计与建模。我们还提出了一种独特的互补数学框架和求解算法，用于建模由部分约束腱产生的分布和集中摩擦力对采用超椭圆函数设计的腱驱动连续型机械臂的张力损失和变形行为的影响。特别是，通过利用该几何函数，我们建立了四个直观的功能映射，将机械臂的几何参数、运动学和变形行为联系起来。借助这些直观映射和超椭圆函数的特性，我们进一步引入了设计空间和设计曲线的概念，以便于对具有通用弯曲模式几何形状并经历腱张力损失的腱驱动连续型机械臂进行直观设计。为全面评估该新型框架及其上述特性的性能，我们针对基于超椭圆函数设计和制造的腱驱动连续型机械臂进行了多项仿真和实验研究。随后，使用不同的误差指标对结果进行了分析和比较。

Authors: Yang Liu, Farshid Alambeigi

SWAM: State-aware World Action Model for Multi-Agent 3D Environments WorldModel

world action model state-aware multi-agent autoregressive diffusion NPC consistency

简要说明：SWAM提出了一种状态感知的世界动作模型，将NPC状态演化与自回归视觉生成分离，在交互式3D环境中实现无需显式场景几何的长期一致生成。

TLDR: SWAM proposes a state-aware world action model that separates NPC state evolution from autoregressive visual generation in interactive 3D environments, enabling consistent long-horizon generation without explicit scene geometry.

Abstract: Interactive world models generate virtual environments autoregressively from player actions and visual history. However, visual history alone cannot reliably capture the evolving states of independently acting non-player characters (NPCs) in real games, particularly when they are outside the camera view. Recent multi-agent world models address this challenge through joint multi-view generation or persistent shared state, but often rely on external observations, like maps or scene geometry, or predefined state transitions. We present SWAM, a State-aware World Action Model that separates agent-state evolution from autoregressive visual generation in interactive 3D environments. A lightweight state model propagates character dynamics from actions without consuming generated frames, combining motion priors with learned scene-dependent corrections. The predicted states then guide an autoregressive diffusion transformer alongside visual history through a novel conditioning scheme. Rather than requiring an explicit scene geometry map or visibility tests, the conditioning indicates where characters may appear, allowing the diffusion model to learn their appearance and occlusion. This design enables NPCs to evolve independently of visual generation while maintaining consistent observations across visibility changes, interactions, and respawns. Evaluations in a custom Godot-based first-person shooter game demonstrate improvements in visual fidelity, NPC consistency, and long-horizon stability over existing approaches.

摘要（中文）：交互式世界模型根据玩家动作和视觉历史自回归地生成虚拟环境。然而，仅依靠视觉历史无法可靠地捕捉真实游戏中独立行动的非玩家角色（NPC）的演化状态，尤其是在这些角色位于相机视野之外时。近年来，多智能体世界模型通过联合多视角生成或持久化共享状态来应对这一挑战，但往往依赖外部观测（如地图或场景几何信息）或预定义的状态转移规则。我们提出了SWAM，一种状态感知的世界动作模型（State-aware World Action Model），它将智能体状态的演化与交互式3D环境中的自回归视觉生成相分离。一个轻量级状态模型仅根据动作传播角色动态，无需消耗生成的帧，将运动先验与学习到的场景相关修正相结合。预测得到的状态随后通过新颖的条件注入机制，与视觉历史一起引导自回归扩散Transformer。该机制无需显式的场景几何地图或可见性测试，而是指示角色可能出现的位置，使扩散模型能够自行学习其外观和遮挡关系。这一设计使得NPC能够在独立于视觉生成的同时演化，并在可见性变化、交互和重生过程中保持观测一致性。在基于Godot引擎定制的第一人称射击游戏中的评估表明，与现有方法相比，该方法在视觉保真度、NPC一致性和长时程稳定性方面均有显著提升。

Authors: Jenna Kang, Bingxuan Li, Colin Groth, Anatolii Evdokimov, Sai Zhang, Qi Sun

LiveAudio: From Bidirectional to Autoregressive Diffusion for Real-Time Streaming Video-to-Audio Generation Other

streaming video-to-audio autoregressive diffusion causal fine-tuning real-time generation synchronization

简要说明：LiveAudio通过渐进式因果微调和蒸馏，将双向视频到音频扩散模型转换为流式自回归生成器，实现实时同步的音频生成，适用于直播和交互式世界模型。

TLDR: LiveAudio converts a bidirectional video-to-audio diffusion model into a streaming autoregressive generator via progressive causal fine-tuning and distillation, enabling real-time, synchronized audio generation for live video streams and interactive world models.

Abstract: Video-to-audio generation synthesizes sound that matches a video in content and timing, with applications ranging from film post-production to live streaming, games and interactive world models. Interactive applications receive video continuously and need the sound to follow it in real time, yet most existing video-to-audio models are bidirectional and must observe an entire clip before producing any sound. We propose LiveAudio, a streaming video-to-audio framework that generates high-quality and synchronized audio in real time while the video is playing. In contrast to prior streaming models trained from scratch, LiveAudio converts a bidirectional model into a streaming generator so as to build on its audio quality and synchronization. LiveAudio generates audio block by block, and each block depends only on the video that has already been played. The streaming generator is obtained from the bidirectional model through progressive causal fine-tuning and distillation, so that each block needs only a few sampling steps. Experiments on VGGSound show that LiveAudio outperforms existing streaming models in audio quality and synchronization, and surpasses the bidirectional model it starts from in synchronization. On a single A100 GPU, it runs in real time with a real-time factor of 0.79 and a time to first frame of 143 ms. Audio samples are available at https://streamaudio.github.io.

摘要（中文）：视频到音频生成技术能够合成与视频在内容和时间上匹配的声音，其应用范围涵盖电影后期制作、直播、游戏及交互式世界模型等。交互式应用需持续接收视频，并要求声音能够实时同步跟随，然而现有的大多数视频到音频模型均为双向模型，必须观察完整个片段才能产生任何声音。为此，我们提出LiveAudio，一种流式视频到音频框架，能够在视频播放过程中实时生成高质量且同步的音频。与以往从头训练的流式模型不同，LiveAudio将双向模型转换为流式生成器，从而继承其音频质量和同步性能。LiveAudio逐块生成音频，每个音频块仅依赖于已播放的视频内容。该流式生成器通过渐进式因果微调和蒸馏技术从双向模型中获得，使得每个音频块只需少量采样步骤即可完成。在VGGSound上的实验表明，LiveAudio在音频质量和同步性方面均优于现有流式模型，并且在同步性上超越了其源双向模型。在单块A100 GPU上，它能够实时运行，实时因子达0.79，首帧延迟为143毫秒。音频样本可在https://streamaudio.github.io获取。

Authors: Yuxuan Jiang, Zehua Chen, Yusheng Dai, Andong Wang, Weibei Dou, Jun Zhu

AxE: Benchmarking Agent-Environment Generalization of Video World Models via Grounded Events WorldModel

video world models generalization grounded events vision-language evaluation conditional video generation

简要说明：AxE Bench 是一个基准测试，用于评估视频世界模型在智能体和环境变化下的泛化能力，通过基于视频的事件和视觉语言评估来度量时间与语义保真度。

TLDR: AxE Bench is a benchmark for evaluating the generalization of video world models across agent and environment changes, using grounded events and a vision-language evaluation harness to measure temporal and semantic fidelity.

Abstract: Edge cases are not the long tail; they are the norm. An embodied system deployed across changing environments, bodies, objects, and tasks will routinely encounter combinations that were absent from its training data. General-purpose physical intelligence therefore requires world models that reuse prior knowledge, predict consequences, and adapt with little or no additional training. Yet current evaluations of conditional video generation emphasize visual quality, prompt alignment, or isolated physical plausibility, leaving systematic generalization difficult to measure. We introduce AxE Bench, a benchmark that organizes condition changes along eight factors of the acting agent and of its environment, and pairs every original condition with controlled variants that change one side or both. WBench-plus applies the same structure to an existing multi-turn benchmark, pairing each WBench scenario with variants on the environment side, through its world setting or camera behavior, or on the agent side, through its interaction instructions. Additionally, to score generated futures, we develop an evaluation harness that combines vision-language reasoning with targeted computer-vision evidence, converting each video into temporally localized events and comparing generated events with reference events in both time and semantics. We summarize each model with the AxE Score, event Fidelity weighted by its Stability across original-variant pairs. Across twenty models, generated events match reference events far more often in timing than in content: no model exceeds a Fidelity of 13.01, the highest Stability is 0.55, and the highest AxE Score is 7.10. Together, these components turn world-model generalization from an informal aspiration into a falsifiable evaluation program for real and simulated interactions. Our project website can be found at: AxEBench.github.io

摘要（中文）：边缘情况并非长尾分布，而是常态。一个在变化的环境、身体、物体和任务中部署的具身系统，将频繁遭遇其训练数据中未曾出现的组合。因此，通用物理智能需要能够复用先验知识、预测后果，并在极少或无需额外训练的情况下进行适应的世界模型。然而，当前对条件视频生成的评估侧重于视觉质量、提示对齐或孤立的物理合理性，导致系统化泛化难以度量。我们引入了AxE Bench基准，该基准沿着行为主体及其环境的八个因素组织条件变化，并将每个原始条件与改变单侧或双侧的受控变体配对。WBench-plus将相同的结构应用于现有的多轮基准，将每个WBench场景与环境侧的变体（通过其世界设置或相机行为）或主体侧的变体（通过其交互指令）配对。此外，为对生成的未来进行评分，我们开发了一套评估工具，将视觉语言推理与针对性的计算机视觉证据相结合，将每个视频转换为时间定位事件，并在时间和语义上将生成事件与参考事件进行比较。我们通过AxE Score（事件保真度乘以其在原始-变体对上的稳定性加权）来总结每个模型。在二十个模型中，生成事件与参考事件在时间上的匹配频率远高于内容上的匹配频率：没有模型的保真度超过13.01，最高稳定性为0.55，最高AxE Score为7.10。综合来看，这些组件将世界模型的泛化从一种非正式愿景转变为对真实和模拟交互的可证伪评估程序。我们的项目网站位于：AxEBench.github.io
